name: Sample
description: A reference extension that exercises every pluggable surface: a move, an oracle, a foe (with a bundled portrait), an override patching a base foe, an asset (with a bundled icon), a roll-table (resolver oracle), a settlement culture, and a character field of each kind (radio, counter, switch, notes). Off by default; enable it in Settings → Expansions to see everything appear.
